title: OpsFlow Task Envelope v1
description: Canonical envelope for asynchronous OpsFlow tasks transported through the event-driven messaging system.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this task message instance.

kind.description: Identifies this envelope as a command/task rather than a domain event.

task_type.description: Stable dot-delimited task name such as incident.notification.requested.

schema_version.description: Version of the OpsFlow task-envelope contract.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp representing when the producer created the task.

producer.description: Stable identifier for the component that created the task.

correlation_id.description: Identifier shared by tasks that belong to the same logical workflow.

causation_id.description: Identifier of the task or event that caused this task to exist. Null when the task begins a workflow.

idempotency_key.description: Stable business-operation key used to suppress duplicate side effects.

metadata.description: Optional non-business execution or tracing metadata.
